I don't tell people because I don't think they would understand. I miss things I used to care about, but I don't think that means I'm broken or that I'm stuck forever. I know I'm not completely unlovable because once, when I showed up late to a friend's party, they didn't act like I was a burden. I wonder if there might be a way forward, even if I can't see it clearly yet, and even if I'm not as far from it as I sometimes think. I don't ask for help because I don't believe anyone would really know what to do. I don't think this is who I am, but I also don't think it's not who I am.
